title: Locally, a stratum of a constructible partition is closed with quasi-compact complement
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme and $Y= igsqcup_{
u=1}^N Y_
u$ a finite partition of its underlying set into pairwise disjoint subsets, each locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] and constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Let $y\in Y$ and let $k$ be the index with $y\in Y_k$. Then there is an affine open subscheme $V\subseteq Y$ with $y\in V$ such that: (1) $Y_k\cap V$ is closed in $V$; (2) for every $
u$ the set $Y_
u\cap V$ is locally closed and constructible in $V$; (3) the open subset $V\setminus(Y_k\cap V)$ is quasi-compact.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 005J (label lemma-open-immersion-constructible-inverse-image: $E\cap U$ is constructible in an open $U$), Lemma Tag 0901 (label lemma-constructible-hausdorff-quasi-compact: the constructible topology of a spectral space is quasi-compact, so a constructible subset, closed in it, is quasi-compact), with Algebra Lemma Tag 090M (Spec of a ring is spectral); the locally closed subset $Y_k$ is closed in some open $W\ni y$ and $V$ is chosen affine inside $W$

proof.text: From local closedness of S k, write S k = W ∩ Z with W open and Z closed. Regard W as an open of Y and use Mathlib theorem exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset to choose an affine open V containing y and contained in W. The equality of preimages S k ∩ V = Z ∩ V is proved by extensionality, so the selected preimage is closed.

For each i, local closedness is preserved by the continuous subtype inclusion V → Y via IsLocallyClosed.preimage. Constructibility is preserved by the open embedding subtype inclusion via IsConstructible.preimage_of_isOpenEmbedding, which is the formal version of restriction to an open.

The complement of the selected preimage is constructible by Boolean complement and open-embedding preimage. Obtain CompactSpace V from Scheme.compactSpace_of_isAffine, the compactness clause of lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs, and apply IsConstructible.isRetrocompact followed by IsRetrocompact.isCompact to conclude compactness.
